Convert data to demography and StMoMo objects

Source: R/data-convert.R
as_demogdata.Rd

Exports observed deaths and exposures for cross-checks with the original packages: as_demogdata() returns a demogdata object of the demography package with one series per stratum (rates and exposures as population), and as_stmomodata() a StMoMoData object of the StMoMo package for one stratum (central exposures). The data must be on the grid (deaths and exposures in the same age groups and single years). as_mt_data() converts in the other direction.

Usage

as_demogdata(data, name = "mortensor")

as_stmomodata(data, stratum = NULL, name = "mortensor")

Arguments

data

An mt_data object.

name

Name of the population.

stratum

Label of the stratum for as_stmomodata() (default: the first).

Value

A demogdata or StMoMoData object.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("demography", quietly = TRUE)) {
  x <- mt_example(deaths = "single", years = 2001:2010)
  dd <- as_demogdata(x)
  names(dd$rate)
}
#> Registered S3 methods overwritten by 'demography':
#>   method      from 
#>   print.lca   e1071
#>   summary.lca e1071
#> [1] "female" "male"
